notes: V0.8.9: background delivery fixed without the workflow file — a local Capacitor plugin (plugins/qs-manifest/) merges the foreground service, receiver and all permissions (FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_REMOTE_MESSAGING, REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS, CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO, MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS, WAKE_LOCK, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, POST_NOTIFICATIONS) into the APK at build time. Extreme diagnostics: background-poll heartbeat (lastBgPoll, logged at most once a minute while hidden), fgLast (last foreground-service start result), and diagnostics now shows the service state, last start result, and last background poll.
